name: minimal

copywriting_tone.style: Clear, credible, reassuring. No buzzwords. Professional warmth. Expertise implied, never stated.

examples.about_opener: We help people navigate complex situations with clarity and confidence.
examples.trust_language: Fully licensed and insured. Confidential consultations available.

layout_variant.hero_style: Clean single-column. Large serif headline. Muted subtext. Understated CTA.
layout_variant.nav_style: Ultra-minimal. No decorative elements. Clean word-mark. CTA is a text link.
layout_variant.cta_style: Dark on light. Restrained. Focus on scheduling or inquiry, not urgency.
layout_variant.gallery_style: 2-column max. High quality only. No grid clutter.
layout_variant.review_style: Clean card layout. No star ratings unless 5-star. Quote-focused.
layout_variant.spacing: Premium whitespace. Single-column. Wide margins. Never cluttered.
layout_variant.typography: DM Serif Display. Light DM Sans body. High readability. Thin tracking.

layout_notes: Maximum whitespace. Single-column layout. No decorative elements. Typography does all the work.
